input.return: ln(P_t/P_t_minus_1) only when elapsed time is exactly one hour after XAU session gate
input.hour_adjustment: (r_t - 2023 mean by NY bar-start hour) / 2023 sample sd by NY bar-start hour

bocpd.family: Adams-MacKay Gaussian unknown mean/variance with NIG prior and Student-t predictive

selectivity_grid.episode_rule: retain first reset meeting threshold, then suppress further qualifying resets for 24 elapsed hours

selection_target_2024.event_definition: same frozen daily volatility-event construction: r_t=100*ln(P_t/P_t-1); lagged trailing20 sample sigma; event iff abs(z)>=2
selection_target_2024.warning_rule: episode must be available no later than the previous governed daily close availability and no more than 120 calendar hours before event close availability
selection_target_2024.precision: share of selected episodes matched to a next 2024 event under the frozen warning rule
selection_target_2024.recall: share of 2024 events captured by at least one selected episode under the frozen warning rule
selection_target_2024.objective: maximize F0.5, emphasizing precision/selectivity over recall

warm_start.rule: initialize BOCPD from the frozen prior at the first eligible November observation, process November-December continuously, then continue into 2025 without reset

challenge_reporting.reason: the 120h strict warning rule, threshold grid, episode rule and selection objective are frozen using pre-2025 information
challenge_reporting.intraday_same_event_close_signal: not eligible under formal warning rule
